V5_BASELINE.objective: Establish controlled six-class DenseNet-121 ERM baseline on Unified Dataset V5
V5_BASELINE.train_cohort: V5 Train Partition (70% patient-isolated, all 6 classes multi-source)

V5_SOURCE_HOLDOUT.objective: Evaluate bidirectional cross-hospital generalization across all multi-source classes
V5_SOURCE_HOLDOUT.test_cohort: Source B held-out independent hospital domain
V5_SOURCE_HOLDOUT.leakage_controls: Strict source isolation; zero cross-source patient overlap

V5_VIEW_CONTROLLED.objective: Isolate institutional/scanner domain shift by strictly filtering cross-source evaluation to PA erect radiographs
V5_VIEW_CONTROLLED.leakage_controls: Exclusion of all AP bedside and non-PA radiographs

V5_MONTGOMERY_EXTERNAL.objective: External zero-shot clinical validation on quarantined Montgomery County archive (N=138)
V5_MONTGOMERY_EXTERNAL.test_cohort: Montgomery County (58 TB cases, 80 Normal controls)
V5_MONTGOMERY_EXTERNAL.leakage_controls: Zero Montgomery images admitted into training, validation, or threshold tuning

V5_DOMAIN_GENERALIZATION_01.objective: Implement and evaluate proposed domain-generalization method (DANN/CORAL/MMD) against frozen baseline
V5_DOMAIN_GENERALIZATION_01.train_cohort: V5 Train Partition with domain labels
V5_DOMAIN_GENERALIZATION_01.test_cohort: Identical V5 Internal Test, Source-Holdout, View-Controlled, and Montgomery cohorts
V5_DOMAIN_GENERALIZATION_01.model: Domain-Invariant Architecture (Backbone + Task Classifier + Domain Regularizer)
V5_DOMAIN_GENERALIZATION_01.leakage_controls: Identical frozen partitions; zero test-set peeking
